name: Splash Summer -Natsu no Shizuku-
source:
Main character transfers to another school in the middle of semester. He is invited to enter swimming club. This is a story of a bargain of love with three people he meets in the swimming club.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在学期中途转学，并受邀加入游泳社。这是一个围绕他在游泳社邂逅的三个人展开的爱情角力故事。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
